hotspots.title: Vox 29N Campaign Launch & Remigration Push
hotspots.blurb: With Spain's general election just days away, Vox has escalated its closing campaign strategy with hardline anti-immigration rhetoric ('not one more fits') and sharp attacks on government corruption. Santiago Abascal is simultaneously warning the Popular Party against 'useful vote' traps while positioning Vox to capture alienated voters following regional flooding controversies.
hotspots.affect: This story commands dominant attention due to the extreme affective investment surrounding the 29N election, high-stakes political ultimatums, and aggressive anti-migrant framing.

hotspots.title: Péter Magyar Meets Zelenskyy in Historic Transcarpathian Summit
hotspots.blurb: Tisza Party leader Péter Magyar's high-profile meeting with Volodymyr Zelenskyy in Transcarpathia continues to drive intense political debate across Hungary. While Magyar announced breakthroughs on minority rights and energy supply, Fidesz loyalists and state media have launched aggressive counter-offensives accusing Magyar of undermining national interests and making concessions on Ukrainian imports.
hotspots.affect: The diplomatic engagement generates intense heat by directly challenging Viktor Orbán's foreign policy narrative and provoking polarized accusations of foreign alignment versus patriotic renewal.

hotspots.title: Swedish Government Crisis & SD Coalition Negotiations
hotspots.blurb: Sweden faces imminent political turmoil as Prime Minister Ulf Kristersson prepares for a crucial parliamentary vote while the Sweden Democrats (SD) push demanding budget counter-proposals. Internal revolts within Centerpartiet regarding cooperation with SD and Jimmie Åkesson's public attacks on coalition partners have heightened fears of government collapse.
hotspots.affect: High affective investment stems from existential coalition instability, accusations of ideological betrayal, and SD's assertive kingmaker posture.

hotspots.title: Jair Bolsonaro Hospitalized with Severe Intestinal Obstruction
hotspots.blurb: Former Brazilian President Jair Bolsonaro remains hospitalized in the intensive care unit following emergency surgery for intestinal obstruction. While medical bulletins report stable recovery, right-wing media outlets maintain heightened vigil, mixing sympathy mobilization with indignation over ongoing judicial actions against his inner circle.
hotspots.affect: The issue maintains high emotional intensity through health anxiety surrounding the right-wing leader coupled with grievance over perceived judicial persecution.

hotspots.title: Trump Backlash Over Reinstating Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang
hotspots.blurb: Reports that defense officials in the Trump administration considered wartime emergency statutes to compel Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang's return have reignited political contention in Washington. Vice President JD Vance has sought to downplay talk of presidential pardons or criminal investigations, while conservative commentators debate administration overreach.
hotspots.affect: Commanding ongoing interest due to contentious debates over executive power, wartime emergency measures, and corporate independence.
